title: Unsettling Lamp
description: Each combat, the first time you play a card that [gold]Debuffs[/gold] an enemy, double its effect.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic triggers on the first card you play in a combat that applies a Debuff to an enemy. Once triggered, all Debuff effects from that specific card are doubled for the remainder of the combat. The effect deactivates after the triggering card is played.
